lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white blobs are arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, following a non-linear grid distribution across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a lattice pattern where the blobs serve as high-luminance nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin displays a high density of small, high-contrast white spots, particularly visible on its dorsal surface and along the trailing edge.
